name: NGL Fine Chem Ltd
title: NGL Fine Chem Ltd - 524774 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 57% YoY to ₹149.23 cr with EBITDA margin 14.35%, but Phase-II commissioning slipped to early Q2 FY27 and margins are only partially price-recovered; China pricing is turning.

utilisation.quote: It is, the Phase-1 is now more or less operational at about 70 %, 80%.

capex.quote: Of the total planned capex of ₹210 crores, we have invested ₹182.75 crores up to Q4 FY26.

triggers.label: Phase-1 utilisation ~70-80%
triggers.quote: the Phase-1 is now more or less operational at about 70 %, 80%

triggers.label: China starts raising prices
triggers.quote: there is an increase in prices coming from China also

triggers.label: Phase-II delayed to early Q2 FY27
triggers.quote: commissioning of Phase II, which was earlier expected in Q1 FY27, is now scheduled for early Q2 FY27

triggers.label: Price pass-through only partial
triggers.quote: We have been partially successful in passing on price increase, not fully successful

triggers.label: EBITDA margin target 15-18% held
triggers.quote: we expect to reach EBITDA level of between 15% and 18%

guidance.quote: we expect to reach EBITDA level of between 15% and 18%
we remain on track to commence commercial production from H2 FY27, as previously guided
Of the total planned capex of ₹210 crores, we have invested ₹182.75 crores up to Q4 FY26.
we should be able to get to that level over the next three to four years
we anticipate a significant sort of revenue starting only from the next financial year. That is 2027-28.

red_flags.quote: it depends entirely on the regulator. So, there is no control that we have over the same.
